en:
Hello…
Lovely weather, isn't it?\lIt's so pleasant…\p…Oh, dear…
I must have dozed off. Welcome.\pMy name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.\pI am a student of the art of
flower arranging.\pMy POKéMON are solely of the
GRASS type.\p…Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that
you wished to challenge me.\pVery well, but I shall not lose.{PLAY_BGM MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
Oh!\nI concede defeat.\lYou are remarkably strong.\pI must confer on you the\nRAINBOWBADGE.
You are cataloging POKéMON?\nI must say I'm impressed.\pI would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.
The RAINBOWBADGE will make\nPOKéMON up to Lv. 50 obey.\pIt also allows POKéMON to use\nSTRENGTH in and out of battle.\pPlease also take this with you.
{PLAYER} received TM19\nfrom ERIKA.
TM19 contains GIGA DRAIN.\pHalf the damage it inflicts is\ndrained to heal your POKéMON.\pWouldn't you agree that it's a\nwonderful move?
You should make room for this.
I should tell you about this GYM.\pOnly real ladies are allowed in\nhere!
You're too rough!
Bleaah!\nI hope ERIKA wipes you out!
Oh, welcome.\nI was getting bored.
My makeup!
GRASS-type POKéMON are tough\nagainst the WATER type.\pThey also have an edge on ROCK-\nand GROUND-type POKéMON.
…Weren't you peeking in here\nearlier?
You're an eye-opener!
Oh, you were looking at ERIKA…\nYou weren't looking at me…
Look, look!\nSee my POKéMON!\pI like the GRASS type.\nI like how they're easy to raise.
No!
We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!
Oh, hey!\pWe don't like BUG- or FIRE-type\nPOKéMON in here!
Oh!\nYou!
Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.
Pleased to meet you.\nMy hobby is POKéMON training.
Oh!\nSplendid!
I have a blind date coming up.\nI have to learn to be polite,\lespecially if I have to battle.
Welcome to CELADON GYM!\pYou'd better not underestimate\nthe nice ladies here.
Oh!\nBeaten!
I didn't bring my best POKéMON.\nWait until next time!
CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}
CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
